svg.title: Отжимания от скамьи сзади — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow white contour, vector traced. Draw two phases of a precise single-bench triceps dip, two side-view panels separated by a WIDE clean black gutter. Same fully clothed man with athletic shoes and same one flat exercise bench behind his hips per panel. In both poses both of his hands grip the near edge of the one seat behind him, hips hovering in front of the seat. His legs extend diagonally down-forward and heels stay planted on the FLOOR; only one bench per panel, no equipment under the feet. Left panel top: elbows nearly straight, hips elevated, both heels down. Right panel bottom: elbows bent backward and hips lowered near the bench edge, both heels still planted. Visible bench legs with base ending at floor height, no floor lines bridging panel gap. Keep the contact points and profile camera fixed. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
